say:3:1511253002:1.text: Other than going through the swamp or climbing over the mountains, this is the only way to leave the forest from the north.
say:3:1511253002:1.source_cn: 如果不跨越沼泽、翻越群山，只有这一条路能从北方离开丛林。

say:4:1511253003:1.source_cn: 可能是巨蛛王将这里作为巢穴后，原本的道路被摧毁了。

say:5:1511253004:0.text: We'll need to find a path around. It'll just take a bit more effort.
say:5:1511253004:0.source_cn: 那就绕路。多费点力气罢了。

say:15:1511253011:0.source_cn: 缇洛亚，我知道你想靠自己的力量抵达薄暮丛林，但路途遥远...

say:16:1511253012:1.text: Please, allow us to do you this kindness. Let Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I see you safely on your way... by means of <style="highlight">teleportation magic</style>.

say:21:1511253020:1.text: But Tilaya, we can only take you so far. Once we teleport you, how you survive in that unfamiliar wilderness, how you build a new home... all of that will be in your hands alone.
say:21:1511253020:1.source_cn: 但是缇洛亚，我们只能送你们抵达那附近。穿过传送门之后，...

say:23:1511253022:1.text: The path to paradise was never meant to be an easy one. Our people must understand the trials that await them. Only then will they choose to follow me of their own will.
say:23:1511253022:1.source_cn: 通往理想之乡的路，注定不会好走。大家知道自己将要面临什...

say:25:1511253024:1.text: We said we'd take this journey slow... I didn't expect it to end so soon.

say:26:1511253025:1.text: No matter how slow we talk, we will have to part ways eventually. I know there's no way around it...
say:26:1511253025:1.source_cn: ……不管走得多慢，总要分开。没办法，我知道。

say:27:1511253026:1.text: But that doesn't mean we're not friends anymore! I know you're going to turn the whole tribe upside down when you get back. You'd better carve my name into the totem pole too! Consider it my way of being right there with you.

say:28:1511253027:0.text: In that case, I'll make your name impossible to miss. It'll be so big, you'll be able to see it from the other side of the world.
say:28:1511253027:0.source_cn: 那我就给你留下最大最明显的标志，让你就算在大陆另一头也...

say:29:1511253028:0.text: Ha! Now that's the girl I grew up with!

say:40:1511253039:0.text: To the Wildborn, this isn't just a flower. A softplume represents resilience. It can survive any catastrophe. Even after a wildfire burns everything to ash, this... this is what grows back first.

say:46:1511253044:1.text: Once the Dark Forest is secured, spreading this flower will be my first priority. I will make the symbol of our perseverance bloom across every corner of our new home.
say:46:1511253044:1.source_cn: 等在薄暮丛林安定下来，我会将它播散下去，让这种花开遍理想乡。
